<section class="resources-section">

        <aside class="left-sidebar">
            <div class="sidebar-sticky-content">
                <nav class="toc-nav">
                    <h3 class="sidebar-heading">Resources</h3>
                    <ul class="sidebar-links">

                        <li><a href="bibliography.html" class="active">Bibliography</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </nav>

        </aside>

        <main class="main-content-area">
            <div class="page-section">
                <h2 class="section-heading">Interactive Bibliography</h2>
                <p class="page-subtitle">Search and explore references in biomechanics and control</p>
            </div>

            <div id="bibliography-app">
                <div class="search-controls" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                    <input type="text" id="bib-search" placeholder="Search references by title, author, or concept..." style="width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-secondary); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 1rem;">
                </div>
                <div id="bib-sort-controls">
                    <!-- Sort buttons will be injected here by JS -->
                    <span id="bib-count">Loading...</span>
                </div>
                <div id="bib-list" class="resource-grid">
                    <p>Loading bibliography...</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </main>

        <aside class="right-sidebar">
             <div class="sidebar-sticky-content">
                <div id="bib-details">
                    <!-- Details will appear here on click -->
                     <h3 class="sidebar-heading">Details</h3>
                     <p style="color: var(--text-light);">Select an item to view details.</p>
                </div>
                <div id="metrics-widget" style="margin-top: 2rem;">
                    <!-- Metrics widget will be rendered here -->
                </div>
             </div>
        </aside>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script src="js/bibliography.js"></script>
<script>
  // Render metrics widget when page loads
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (window.AffineDriftMetrics) {
      setTimeout(function() {
        window.AffineDriftMetrics.renderStatsWidget('metrics-widget');
      }, 500);
    }
  });
</script>
